verdict.rationale: Rootly documents a public REST API with generated API keys and roles, a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, and an API changelog. The changelog shows endpoints reaching beyond incident creation, such as status-page events and email alert-source notification targets. An official MCP server also exposes incident queries, on-call schedules and actions to agents. However, nothing in the evidence claims or demonstrates that the API matches the UI, and much of the documented surface (retrospective editor, AI blocks, workflows configuration, schedules and escalation-policy setup) is only shown as UI/Slack features. missing for 10: an explicit UI–API parity statement, API coverage evidence for schedules, escalation policies, workflows, retrospectives and status-page configuration, and independent or hands-on confirmation of API completeness.
